title: Product ad from nothing
pitch: A hero still, the same product moving, a second camera on the same moment, a score, cut on the beat.
why: Reshoot films the first clip again from a new angle, so the product in the second shot is the same one, not a lookalike. That is what keeps an ad from falling apart.

fields.label: The product
fields.default: a faceted perfume bottle of smoked glass with a gold cap and no label

tips: Plain surfaces with no print: blank products invent logos when they are told nothing.
Reshoot is the slow step, about 8 minutes here.

steps.label: Cut on the beat
steps.what: Finds the tempo and beats in the song, picks its loudest section, and cuts each clip on a beat. Loudness normalized.

expected.basis: sum of each step's measured time on this box, with a cold start per step

raw_steps.label: Hero still
raw_steps.prompt: Luxury advertising photograph of {product} standing on wet black obsidian, thin emerald rim light, gold dust suspended in the air, shallow depth of field, dark studio background. No text, no logos.

raw_steps.label: Hero shot
raw_steps.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Product advertising film, cinematic. The product stands still on the wet black stone while gold dust drifts slowly through the light and a thin line of water runs across the stone. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the product. One continuous shot, no cuts.

overall_soundscape: A low soft hum, tiny water drips.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

raw_steps.label: Score
raw_steps.prompt:
Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 112. Minimal electronic, cinematic.
Global Emotional Progression: It opens with a single pulse and rises to a clean, confident finish.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: Under picture from start to finish.
Sonics & Production Profile: A clean, wide mix with a steady pulse that is easy to cut to.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: No vocals. Purely instrumental.
Vocal Style: No vocals.
Harmony/Backing Vocals: None.
Vocal FX: None.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: a deep warm synth bass, soft felt piano, crisp minimal percussion.
Secondary: Soft pads and quiet textures that widen as it builds.
Groove & Foundation Progression: A clear, even 112 BPM pulse from the first bars, with percussion joining as it grows.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Risers and swells into each new section.
